title: Crowdstrike Global IT Outage Explained! (Hint: Not a Cyber Incident!)
description:
Millions of computers went offline Friday 7/19/24 causing outages in 911 Call Centers, Airports and Traffic Control, Banks and ATMs, and much much more. In this video, I explain how this happened and why this incident had such a major impact.

00:00 Introduction and Welcome
00:16 Overview of the Global IT Meltdown
01:32 Details of the CrowdStrike Outage
02:48 Impact on Windows Machines
05:28 Recovery Efforts and Challenges
07:05 Future Implications and Lessons Learned
10:05 Conclusion and Final Thoughts
